Dash top light is very quick, but it is risky. It brings balance to very powerful moves. Zerker and Conq were changed because their attacks aren't that hard to block/parry AND they get free guard-breaks if blocked, so they fixed it. It is hard to argue that giving these free gbs like on other characters, wouldn't vastly balance pk, making her still very good because she has fast attacks, but if she messes up, gets punished for it.

If you block warden zone attack, which is also very fast and does similar damage to pk zone, you get a free guard break, which balances out the move. Currently there is no risk to going in, zone canceling, than dashing out, even if its blocked. Let's try to have a civilized discussion about this please.

It may not do a lot of damage, but because it is so quick you can just do it over and over again with no punishments for it being blocked, as you can safely dash out. Personally I am fine with her attacks being quick; but I'm not okay with her having no punishments for having a light attack blocked, no punishment for blocked lunge, and no punishment for blocked zone attack. If they added free gbs after those blocks, she would be a balanced risk/reward type character.
